cohort: Pregnant women undergoing uncomplicated primary Caesarean section at term (37-42 weeks gestation).
finding: Early oral feeding after uncomplicated primary Caesarean section is safe, well-tolerated, and associated with earlier return of bowel functions, less intravenous fluid requirements, and reduced hospital stay compared to delayed feeding.
followup_time: Up to hospital discharge (approximately 3-4 days post-C-section)
